portal.vendor_source: portal fingerprint (2026-09-29): an Acolnet CGI register ('ACOLNET' markup, acolnetcgi.gov?ACTION=UNWRAP&RIPNAME=Root.pgesearch search, Root.PgeResultDetail&TheSystemkey=<n> detail, multipart search forms with a RIPSESSION token). Acolnet has no vendor id or recipe here, hence custom-other. Documents are on a separate hosted viewer (cbc.aifusion.io) over SharePoint Online.

document_host.note: The Acolnet detail page links https://cbc.aifusion.io/planning/publicViewer.html?caseID=<REF>, a script shell. Its publicViewer.js calls an open JSON API: GET https://api.cbc.aifusion.io/planning/docs?caseId=<REF with every / replaced by ->, returning documentsByType[] (type, documents[] with id, filename, url, downloadUrl) and parentCase. Every url and downloadUrl points at centralbedfordshirecouncil.sharepoint.com and needs a Microsoft sign-in (see the sharepoint-sign-in quirk).

committees.name: Wixams Joint Development Control Committee
committees.note: A joint committee for one new settlement, listed as current.

committee_papers.note: Committee ids confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-29; 897 is the committee's site inspections. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: CB/YY/NNNNN/TYPE. The document API takes it with dashes (CB-26-02907-NMA); the viewer page takes it with slashes. The Acolnet detail page is keyed by an internal TheSystemkey, not the reference.

quirks.summary: Every document link in the list is on SharePoint Online and redirects an anonymous client to a Microsoft sign-in page.
quirks.detail: downloadUrl (_layouts/15/download.aspx?UniqueId=...) followed three 302s to login.microsoftonline.com and returned a 26 KB HTML login page. The alternative url field (the /PUBLIC/ folder path, commented out in the viewer's script) 302'd to _layouts/15/Authenticate.aspx. A file saved from either route is HTML, not the document.
quirks.workaround: None by HTTP. Hand the user the viewer link; check each saved file's magic bytes, since the login page arrives with HTTP 200.

quirks.summary: The API's documentCount counts document-type groups, not documents.
quirks.detail: documentCount 3 for a list of 5 documents in three groups (Plans 3, Supporting 1, Application 1); PlanIt's n_documents was 5.

quirks.summary: The document API wants the reference with dashes, CB-26-02907-NMA, not slashes.
quirks.workaround: Replace every / (and \) with - before calling /planning/docs, as the viewer's own script does.

browser_route.note: The council's document viewer for one application. Whether an anonymous browser can open the files was not checked; to a plain HTTP client every file link redirects to a Microsoft sign-in. If it asks the user to sign in, they will need to ask the council for the documents.

endpoints.search: https://plantech.centralbedfordshire.gov.uk/PLANTECH/DCWebPages/acolnetcgi.gov?ACTION=UNWRAP&RIPNAME=Root.pgesearch (not exercised; the document API is keyed by the reference)
endpoints.note: Detail page: acolnetcgi.gov?ACTION=UNWRAP&RIPNAME=Root.PgeResultDetail&TheSystemkey=<n>, which PlanIt's applics 'url' carries; PlanIt's docs_url is the viewer link.

pacing.note: Three requests to plantech, four to cbc.aifusion.io, two to api.cbc.aifusion.io, and two to SharePoint at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-29, no 429 or challenge.

robots.note: No robots.txt on plantech.centralbedfordshire.gov.uk (IIS 404), cbc.aifusion.io or api.cbc.aifusion.io (nginx 404). The viewer page carries a copyright notice (section 47, 1988 Act) and says following the document links means agreeing to it; it does not prohibit automated access.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; no vendor fingerprint matched

Register fingerprinted as Acolnet CGI (kept as custom-other; no Acolnet vendor id exists). PlanIt's applics records (one call) gave CB/26/02907/NMA, its Acolnet detail URL and a docs_url on cbc.aifusion.io. The detail page linked the viewer. The viewer's publicViewer.js named the API; GET api.cbc.aifusion.io/planning/docs?caseId=CB-26-02907-NMA returned 5 documents in 3 groups (PlanIt n_documents 5). The design statement's downloadUrl redirected to login.microsoftonline.com (26,071-byte HTML login page, not a PDF); its url field redirected to SharePoint's Authenticate.aspx. Stopped after that one correction. No file retrieved. Dropped quirk 'vendor-unverified' (vendor fingerprinted in this run). robots.txt checked on three hosts. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee ids.
